# Data Catalog

## Managed configuration

- `config/datasets.yml`: ArcGIS item IDs, metric families, regex field patterns, aggregation rules.
- `config/geographies.yml`: reusable geography-group definitions.
- `config/publish.yml`: boundary layer and hosted output metadata.

## H+T income inputs (`config/ht_income.yml`)

- `data/raw/housing-plus-transportation/H +T Costs ... Composite H + T Metric.csv`: GPI / TDM H and T costs by city area.
- `data/raw/housing-plus-transportation/city_area_with_workshop_areas.shp`: city boundary layer (EPSG:26912).
- `data/raw/housing-plus-transportation/{tracts,counties,places}_2020_acs_income.csv`: cached, gap-filled ACS panels. Delete one to force a re-download.
- `data/raw/housing-plus-transportation/baseline_main_Affordability_Housing_Transportation_Costs.csv`: main-branch output snapshot used for parity checks.
- `data/intermediate/ht_income/`: rebuildable 2020 block-group GeoParquet reference and block-group ACS panel (git-ignored).

## Legacy source artifacts

- `Inputs/Walksheds.gdb.zip`
- `Inputs/Walksheds.gdb/`
- `legacy/housing-plus-transportation/Inputs/`
- `Logs/`

## Canonical maintained outputs

- Intermediates: `data/intermediate/*.parquet`
- Spatial outputs: `data/derived/*.gpkg`
